reuse.why: Reuses NO_SAVED_TEMPLATE, getSheetValue, batchMessages and the undoable mutator registration, but copies the category-selection query rather than extracting a shared selection for the month-wide actions.

duplication.why: The hidden/group-hidden/template category query is a verbatim copy of set3MonthAvg's (already repeated in setZero, set6/12MonthAvg), and the income/tracking skip and expense sign flip are copied as well.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts beside its siblings and is registered in budget/app.ts the same way.

scope.why: Only the action, its registration, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Fits the existing style, but adds one more copy of the category rule that every future change to which categories month actions fill must update.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The tree has no shared category-selection helper to bypass; it uses the shared NO_SAVED_TEMPLATE fragment.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied query and income/sign logic are verbatim, not disguised.
